name: Reactor Coolant Pump Trip (1 of 4)
description: One reactor coolant pump trips. Primary flow steps down, the loop delta-T widens and coolant average temperature transiently rises before controllers respond. With three pumps running the reactor should not trip.
briefing: A single RCP breaker opens at t+30 s. Watch flow, delta-T and T-avg. Decide whether a power reduction is warranted.
learning_objectives: Relate coolant mass flow to core delta-T at constant power
Understand the low-flow reactor trip permissive and why one pump out is tolerable
